country.evidence_quote: Nestled in Switzerland’s Canton of Graubünden, LAAX is where epic powder meets massive jumps and breathtaking mountain views. With 216 km of slopes, 5 snow parks, and the world’s largest permanently operated halfpipe, this laid-back freestyle hub has a vibe that feels more like California than classic Alpine, ideal for anyone who loves their snow days with serious style.
